names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 aprilie, «Sfinții Mucenici Terentie, Pompie, African, Maxim, Macarie și Dima».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Αφρικανός, Θεόδωρος, Μάξιμος, Πομπήιος, Τερέντιος και άλλοι τεσσαράκοντα Μάρτυρες», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the title on this one's name link behind the company's line for 28 октября ст. ст., «Терентий, мч.», with the rank word left off. The line itself declines the name, and neither the line nor the link gives a surname, a see or a place — the forename is the whole of what the Russian calendar prints.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 10 April on pravoslavno.rs, „Св. муч. Теренције, Африкан, Максим, Помпије и осталих 36 с њима.“, where Св. муч. heads the whole company and belongs to no one of them, so each of the four named forenames stands bare. The heading gives him no epithet and no country; Africa is in the body, as the governor's province, and this corpus keeps such a thing in the display name.

feast.note: The Greek and Romanian rows on this folder keep the company on 10 April; this is the Russian calendar's own day for it and not a second day on one calendar. Both are kept because they are different churches.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 28 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Африкана , Терентия , Максима , Помпия и иных 36-ти (III).»
source.note: The line stands in the day's second paragraph, which carries no typikon icon, so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: **This row is a reading and is named as one.** The Russian calendar keeps this company on the Julian 28 October, where the Greek and the Romanian pages this folder was written from keep it on 10 April. That they are one company rests on four things read off the pages: the four names the Russian line prints are the four this corpus holds together off saint.gr «Οι Άγιοι Μάρτυρες Αφρικανός, Θεόδωρος, Μάξιμος, Πομπήιος και Τερέντιος»; both lines are a few named men followed by a number of unnamed companions, 36 here and 33 there; both set the martyrdom in the same persecution, «(III)» against saint.gr's 250; and the four `/name/` pages behind this line each list **28 октября and no other day**, so the Russian calendar has only this one commemoration for them and the two-commemorations-two-men rule is not in play. No place is named on the Russian line, so nothing is read from it onto the Africa this folder's English name carries. Separate from the company of Publius the Greek keeps on 13 March, which this corpus holds in its own folders. No other folder in the corpus stores a bare «Терентий»: the five other Terences hold either a Greek or a Romanian form, or «Терентий Сирийский» with the province, so this form folds onto none of them.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 aprilie — «Sfinții Mucenici Terentie, Pompie, African, Maxim, Macarie și Dima»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Αφρικανός, Θεόδωρος, Μάξιμος, Πομπήιος, Τερέντιος και άλλοι τεσσαράκοντα Μάρτυρες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It enumerates the company: five names in the day's line and forty more in the prose, so forty-five in all, and that is why there is one folder for each. Its three numbers do not agree — the day's line says «και άλλοι τεσσαράκοντα Μάρτυρες», forty other martyrs, the prose says «μαζί με άλλους τριάντα εννέα Χριστιανούς», another thirty-nine, and the list that follows the prose holds forty names. Both readings are the page's and it reconciles neither; nothing here rests on the count. The page tells one martyrdom for all of them and nothing at all of any one of them beyond the name and a gloss on the name. Μακάριος stands in the prose list but has no heading of his own on the page, and Δημᾶς, whom the corpus holds in this company from the Romanian calendar, is not in saint.gr's list at all.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 23.04.2026 (10. април ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Теренције, Африкан, Максим, Помпије и осталих 36 с њима.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek both keep him on. **The heading enumerates four and no more** — Теренције, Африкан, Максим, Помпије — and then says only „и осталих 36 с њима“, and the other thirty-six with them; the body names nobody further. So this entry is **four rows and not forty**, and the other thirty-six took none: the corpus holds forty-five `*-companion-of-terentius` folders off the Greek and Romanian lists, which do enumerate, and giving each of them a row off a collective «other thirty-six» would identify a named man with one of an unnamed thirty-six on nothing but the day — the more plainly so because the counts do not agree, this source making the company forty in all against the corpus's forty-six folders. That is written up in the run's findings. The man is the same beyond doubt: Terentius under Decius, the governor of Africa's proclamation, the forty who stood firm, and the year. **The 250 agrees exactly** with what this folder holds off saint.gr, so **no date was touched**. New to the folder, and a great deal of it: that the governor **divided them into two groups**, beheading the thirty-six after scourging, scraping and the salting of their open wounds, and keeping **these four** in prison in heavy irons at the neck, the hands and the feet; that **an angel of God appeared in the prison, touched the irons so that they fell off, and then set them an abundant table and fed them**; that they were brought out, tortured and shut up again; that the governor had his **sorcerers gather as many venomous creatures, snakes and scorpions, as they could and shut them in the same room**, and that the creatures would not touch the servants of God but huddled in one corner and lay there three days, and when the prison was opened on the third day **rushed at the sorcerers and bit them**; and that the four **sang psalms joyfully** on the way to the beheading. And it gives Terentius's own words to his companions: let us take care, brothers, not to deny Christ our God, lest He deny us before His heavenly Father and the holy angels. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, the troparion page for the martyrs Terentie, Pompei, African, Maxim, Macarie, Dima and those with them, Glasul 4; the reading «nesctricăciunii» is the page's own

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their struggles have won from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength, they overthrew their tormentors and broke the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Στρατὸς θεοσύλεκτος, πανευκλεῶν Ἀθλητῶν, στερρότητι πίστεως, ἐξ Ἀφρικῆς συνδρομῶν, γενναίως ἠγώνισται σύμφρονες γὰρ τὴ γνώμη, καὶ τοὶς τρόποις ὀφθέντες, σύναθλοι ἐν ἀγώσιν, ἀνεδείχθησαν πάντες. Καὶ νῦν καθικετεύουσι, σώζεσθαι ἀπαντᾷς.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of the martyrs of 10 Απριλίου. It is the proper of this company and names no one of them, addressing them as an army gathered by God out of Africa.

english.text: An army gathered by God, contestants of all renown, running together out of Africa in the firmness of faith, contended nobly; for being of one mind and of one manner they were all shown to be fellow-strugglers in the contests. And now they entreat that all may be saved.

hymns.text: Τῶν ἁγίων Μαρτύρων τά κατορθώματα, οὐρανῶν αἱ δυνάμεις ὑπερεθαύμασαν, ὅτι ἐν σώματι θνητῷ, τόν ἀόρατον ἐχθρόν τῇ δυνάμει τοῦ Σταυροῦ, ἀγωνισάμενοι καλῶς, ἐνίκησαν ἀοράτως, καί νῦν πρεσβεύουσι τῷ Κυρίῳ ἐλεηθῆναι τάς ψυχάς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α’, on the page of the martyrs of 10 Απριλίου. This is the common apolytikion of martyrs, naming nobody; the page prints it under their names, so it is copied whole as the page has it.

english.text: The powers of heaven marvelled at the achievements of the holy martyrs, that in a mortal body they contended well against the invisible enemy by the power of the Cross and conquered invisibly; and now they intercede with the Lord that our souls may find mercy.

hymns.text: Ὡς Χριστοῦ ἀκόλουθοι οἱ Ἀθλοφόροι, ἐν σταδίῳ ἔλεγον, ἀγωνιζόμενοι στεῤῥῶς· Μη δειλιάσωμεν σύναθλοι· τρυφή γὰρ μένει ἡμᾶς ἀδιάδοχος.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ', Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of the martyrs of 10 Απριλίου. It addresses the company together and names none of them.

english.text: As followers of Christ the prize-bearers said in the arena, contending firmly: let us not be afraid, fellow-strugglers, for a delight that has no successor awaits us.

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι Άγιοι Μάρτυρες Αφρικανός, Θεόδωρος, Μάξιμος, Πομπήιος και Τερέντιος μαρτύρησαν το έτος 250 μ.Χ., επί αυτοκράτορα Δεκίου (249-251 μ.Χ.) και ηγεμόνος Φουρτουνιανού, στην Καρθαγένη της Αφρικής». The year is given for the company and the page tells one martyrdom for all of them.
